AgentSettings.agentSectionIdentityDesc: Name, tone, and topics customers should or should not see.
AgentSettings.agentTonePlaceholder: e.g. Friendly and professional, slightly informal
AgentSettings.agentTopicRestrictionsHint: Airi is instructed to avoid these topics.
AgentSettings.agentSectionInstructionsDesc: System instructions added to every reply.
AgentSettings.agentCustomInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Always mention our 30-day return policy. Never recommend competitor products.
AgentSettings.agentGreetingAutoDesc: Send a greeting in the first reply only
AgentSettings.agentGreetingDisabledDesc: Do not add greetings or pleasantries
AgentSettings.agentEscalationSuggestHumanDesc: Tell customers a person can help
AgentSettings.agentEscalationAutoHandoffDesc: Ask for human help when needed; configure routing in scenarios.
AgentSettings.agentSectionRetrievalDesc: Knowledge lookup, chat history, KB links, and language bias.
AgentSettings.agentSectionChannelDesc: Add per-channel instructions only where the default behavior differs.
AgentSettings.agentChannelPlaceholder: e.g. Keep messages under 500 characters. Use emoji sparingly.
AgentSettings.agentSectionActionsDesc: Guide what Airi offers. Use scenarios to run automations.
AgentSettings.agentActionWhenPlaceholder: e.g. Customer mentions price is too high
AgentSettings.agentLoadFailed: Could not load agent settings. Your saved settings are unchanged.
AgentSettings.agentIncompleteAction: Complete both fields or remove the unfinished action.
AgentSettings.whatsappVoiceRepliesDescription: Answer customer voice messages with a short voice note. Long answers, links, interactive messages, and unavailable voice generation use text.
AgentSettings.whatsappVoiceRepliesBillingHint: Available on Pro and Enterprise. Connect your ElevenLabs account; audio usage is billed by ElevenLabs to that account.
AgentSettings.whatsappVoiceRepliesSubscriptionRequired: Upgrade to Pro to enable WhatsApp voice replies.
AgentSettings.whatsappVoiceRepliesElevenlabsRequired: Connect your ElevenLabs account in Integrations to enable voice replies.
